title: Dossier
description: One compact, final research artifact per approved lead, stored at data/leads/<slug>/dossier.json. Downstream steps (email generation, QA) read ONLY this file — never re-audit the site or re-run agents to answer a question this file already answers. V2: `evidence_items[]` is the authoritative evidence list carried forward from opportunity.json -- email generation may only cite facts backed by an item here. `evidence` (string) is kept as a short human-readable summary for V1 compatibility.

evidence_items.description: Carried forward from opportunity.json's evidence[] -- the only facts email generation may cite

observed_at.description: When the strongest finding was observed -- checked against config/limits.yaml: finding_freshness_days before email generation (scripts/check_freshness.py)

ranking_observed_at.description: observed_at of the ranking data backing maps_position/organic_position, if any -- checked against ranking_freshness_days
